_doc: What tools/session_probe holds on every push (the processor's side only: it runs headless, with no graphics, so a green probe says nothing of the GPU; the phone benchmark measures that) (CI, after the tests): the longest frame of each scene ScenePlayer plays (ms on the 2-core runner, scaled by TestSuite's yardstick on a slower one) and the scripts' cost a frame on each farm. A scene's own limit, else the farm's, else `default_max_ms`. Set 22 Nov 2026 from measured runs with room for noise; lowered as the game gets faster, never raised to let a regression through (the owner, 22 Nov: 'we keep circling back to this').
